description: Lightweight but rugged, this cotton canvas tote carries your day with a wink. The natural canvas shows off a vintage-style ink illustration and cheeky line work that quietly starts conversations while you run errands, visit the farmers market, or slide into a study session. The flat, roomy body keeps prints crisp and items organized; long self-fabric handles sit comfortably on the shoulder and reinforced stitching adds confidence at the seams. Choose natural for a warm, lived-in look or black for a bolder contrast—both wear in nicely and resist fading. Bring this tote along for everyday outings where a little humor and practical durability go hand in hand. Product features - 100% heavy cotton canvas (12 oz/yd²) for durability - Flat-corner construction for a neat, structured profile - Self-fabric carrying handles with reinforced stitching - Sewn-in label; blank sourced from India - Available in natural and black colors Care instructions - Do not iron directly over the printed area - print may stick to the iron. - Spot clean - Do not bleach - Line dry
